title.zh: 墨西哥塔可（牧羊人风味）

summary.zh: 腌猪肉与菠萝的旋转炙烤之舞，墨西哥城的深夜灵魂。
summary.en: Marinated pork and pineapple in a spinning dance — the midnight soul of Mexico City.

ingredients.zh: 墨西哥干辣椒 3 个（泡软）
橙汁 100 毫升、白醋 2 大勺

ingredients.en: Diced onion, cilantro, lime to serve

ingredients.zh: 蒜 3 瓣、孜然 1 小勺、牛至 1 小勺
ingredients.en: 3 cloves garlic, 1 tsp each cumin and oregano

steps.zh: 泡软的辣椒与阿奇奥特酱、橙汁、醋、蒜、孜然、牛至打成腌料。
steps.en: Blend soaked chilies with achiote, orange juice, vinegar, garlic, cumin and oregano into a marinade.

steps.zh: 猪肉片与腌料拌匀，冷藏腌制至少 4 小时（隔夜最佳）。
steps.en: Coat pork slices and marinate at least 4 hours — overnight is best.

steps.zh: 菠萝切厚片，平底锅大火烙至两面焦糖化，切小丁。
steps.en: Sear pineapple slices on high heat until caramelized; dice.

steps.zh: 大火热油，分批煎腌好的肉片至边缘微焦，切碎。
steps.en: Fry the pork in batches over high heat until edges char; chop finely.

steps.zh: 玉米饼在干锅上每面烙 20 秒至柔软温热。
steps.en: Warm tortillas on a dry comal, 20 seconds per side, until soft.

steps.zh: 饼上放肉、菠萝丁、洋葱碎、香菜，挤青柠汁，配莎莎酱食用。
steps.en: Fill with pork, pineapple, onion and cilantro; squeeze lime and add salsa.

tips.zh: 肉要切薄，高温快煎出焦边，模仿旋转烤炉的效果。
tips.en: Slice thin and sear hot — charred edges mimic the trompo spit.

tips.zh: 菠萝不可省略，其蛋白酶能让肉质更嫩。
tips.en: Don't skip pineapple — its enzymes tenderize the pork.

tips.zh: 玉米饼用双层更不易破，是墨西哥街头的标准做法。
tips.en: Double up tortillas street-style so they don't break.

failChecks.zh: 肉发柴：切太厚或煎太久，薄片大火快煎。
failChecks.en: Tough pork? Slices too thick or overcooked — thin and fast is the rule.

failChecks.zh: 腌料发苦：辣椒没去籽或烤焦，泡软后去籽再打泥。
failChecks.en: Bitter marinade? Deseed the chilies after soaking.

failChecks.zh: 饼一折就断：玉米饼太干，烙饼时盖湿布保温保湿。
failChecks.en: Tortillas cracking? Keep them wrapped in a cloth to stay moist.

culturalStory.zh: Tacos al Pastor 是移民融合的美味证据：1920 年代黎巴嫩移民把中东旋转烤肉（Shawarma）带到墨西哥普埃布拉，当地人用猪肉取代羊肉、用玉米饼取代皮塔，并加入阿奇奥特与菠萝，「牧羊人塔可」就此诞生。2019 年它被《Taste Atlas》评为世界第一街头美食。深夜的墨西哥城，旋转烤炉前的塔可师傅刀光飞舞，那是这座城市最动人的烟火。
culturalStory.en: Tacos al Pastor is delicious proof of immigrant fusion: in the 1920s, Lebanese migrants brought the shawarma spit to Puebla, Mexico. Locals swapped lamb for pork, pita for corn tortillas, added achiote and pineapple — and the 'shepherd taco' was born. Taste Atlas named it the world's best street food in 2019. Late-night Mexico City, knives flashing before the spinning trompo — the city's most beloved theater.
